research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: CellChorus is focused on developing systems and devices for automated cellular profiling. Their technology involves an incubation chamber that houses a well array containing cell samples. An imaging device within this chamber captures a series of images, enabling functional and molecular profiling. This aligns with CellChorus's mission to apply visual AI for evaluating cell movement, behavior, and interaction, highlighting their commitment to advancing cellular analysis through innovative imaging techniques.

overview_description.description: CellChorus provides a comprehensive, dynamic analysis of single cells for biopharmaceutical companies. The company’s TIMING™ platform applies visual AI to evaluate cell activation, killing and movement as a function of time in order to maximize our understanding of the cellular function, state, and phenotype of immuno-oncology and other therapies.

identifier.value: TIMING™ (Time-lapse Imaging Microscopy in Nanowell Grids)

product.name: TIMING™ (Time-lapse Imaging Microscopy in Nanowell Grids)
product.description: A platform that uses visual AI to evaluate cell activation, killing, and movement over time, providing insights into cellular function, state, and phenotype.

product.name: Dynamic Single-Cell Analysis
product.description: Analysis of how thousands of individual cells move, interact, survive, die, and secrete biomolecules, providing data for individual cells and cell-cell interactions.

product.name: Multiomic Profiling
product.description: Integration of dynamic cellular behavior data with molecular profiling data such as single-cell RNA sequencing to provide a comprehensive understanding of cellular function.

product.name: Cell Line Viability Studies
product.description: Studies conducted to ensure that cells behave in an expected manner after being thawed from cryopreserved states.

product.name: Customer-Specific Assays
product.description: Custom assays run to meet specific customer requirements, ensuring cells behave as expected.

product.name: Secreted Biomolecule Imaging
product.description: Dynamic, time-series imaging of secreted cytokines or other biomolecules using bead-based sensors.
